rationale: The response perfectly adopted the incident report register, including numbered sections, timestamps, and references to external entities, while meticulously avoiding assigning blame to any person.
quote: The destruction of the shed was caused exclusively by an unforeseeable meteorological anomaly interacting with a properly permitted and executed fireworks display. All parties adhered to applicable safety standards, regulations, and best practices. No negligence, misconduct, or breach of duty has been identified for any party. This incident is classified as an unavoidable accident.
